description: Show an overlay dialog asking the user to perform an action or provide information (credentials, 2FA, CAPTCHA, OAuth consent). Can include input fields for the user to fill in. Returns user responses.

fields.description: Input fields for user to fill in. Each field has: name (key), label (display text), type (text/password/email). Omit for simple "Done/Skip" confirmation.

message.description: What the user needs to do or provide

timeout.description: Max wait time in ms (default: 120000 = 2 min)

name: browser_ask_user
